title: SeqGrowGraph: Learning Lane Topology as a Chain of Graph Expansions
caption: Figure 5. Model architecture and inference process. We employ a BEV-encoder to transform surrounding camera perspective view (PV) images into BEV features. Subsequently, a Transformer de- coder generates tokens of the target sequence based on the BEV features and the beginning of sequence < BOS >. All the tokens generated represent a complete lane graph.
